title: Grand Theft Auto 2/Area 1
text:
__TOC__

Tutorial!
Answer the phone at the start by running over to it.

Enter the parked  and you get a  (10 ammo).

Zaibatsu

Drive to the Zaibatsu phone to speak to the boss, Trey Welsh.

Zaibatsu territory is in the northeast quarter of the Downtown District. The Japanese word for conglomerate or wealthy clique, Zaibatsu is a seemingly legitimate corporation active in this and every other district, manufacturing everything from cars to medication. However, beneath the surface it's heavily involved in narcotics, contract-killing and shadow politics. Its s are the second-fastest gang vehicles.

Loonies

Drive to the Loony phone to speak to the boss, Elmo.

Loony territory is in the northwest corner of the Downtown District, where escaped inmates overran the Sunnyside mental institution (named after the mental institution in Montrose, Scotland, near where the game was originally developed).

Yakuza

Drive to the Yakuza phone to speak to the boss, Johnny Zoo.

Yakuza territory is in the southwest quarter of the Downtown District, where they manufacture drugs and own a series of labs along the waterfront.

Return to the Church.

You can now collect Token 13, and you've earned $20,000 by completing the Tutorial!

Weapons
../Weapons/ can always be picked up near every gang phone, and they can spawn again after 15 seconds during play, so you can wait in place until you have maximum 99 ammo.

Most other weapons don't spawn again once picked up, but some do so after 15 seconds:

 A  with 30 ammo can be picked up in Fruitbat, northeast of the yellow Loony phones, where it's in the building east of the Loony Garage targeted in the Zaibatsu  job: it's next to Token 33.
 A  with 5 ammo can be picked up in J-Lab, after entering from Funabashi to the south: this is southwest of the yellow Yakuza phones, and further south of their green ones. After completing the Loony  job by climbing the stairs onto its roof, head east until you see the Rocket Launcher, then jump from crate to crate to pick it up.

Final Job!
The final job starts automatically after completing all 21 jobs for the three gangs. You only have one chance to pass this job: if you fail then you can quit and resume saved status to repeat the final gang job(s). For this reason, saving one of the quicker and easier jobs for last is recommended.

If the Bosses aren't in their own territory then they may drive s instead of a gang vehicle. If you don't destroy their vehicles then once they exit two  shots or equivalent damage will kill them, but the bonus for killing each individually is the same as any normal pedestrian. If you use a  then they keep attacking as they burn, so take evasive action. Better yet, just use a vehicle to run over them.

The Yakuza Boss drives a black  and he's armed with a :

The Zaibatsu Boss drives a  and he's also armed with a S-Uzi Machine Gun:

The Loony Boss drives a black  and he's armed with a Flamethrower, so if you don't have  or  active then it's best to keep him at a distance while using longer-range weapons, or just run over him with a vehicle. If you're burning, you can still pass this job if you're the last to be wasted.

You earn a $60,000 (x Multiplier) bonus, and your Bonus Multiplier increases by 1.

Area Complete!
Once you have $1,000,000: 

If you haven't already done so, then collect all ../Tokens/ and save before leaving the Area to unlock ../Bonus Stages/ A-C (you can also pass all ../Kill Frenzies/).

From the Area Complete! screen you can now select from the following:

 Play Next Area
 Resume d Status
 Replay Previous Area
 Continue, to play one of the Bonus Stages
 Back to Main Menu

If you start play in next area and then save, this overwrites your Area 1 save. You can still start play in Area 1 again, but if you want to keep playing from where you left then you'll need to backup your players folder beforehand: this can be found in GTA2's installation directory, but in later versions of Windows it may be hidden in Drive:/Users/User name/AppData/Local/VirtualStore (open the players folder in the GTA2 directory and check date modified to see whether those files have actually been used).
